title: SIU clears cops in standoff death
article: A provincial investigation agency has cleared city police of any blame in last month's shooting of a man during a standoff.
David Melzer was found dead in the kitchen of his parents' bullet- riddled home after an 11-hour armed standoff and several exchanges of gunfire June 2.
"We are pleased especially for our officers," Deputy Chief Brian Collins said.
There are no grounds to believe that any of the involved officers are criminally liable, said Peter Tinsley, director of the province's Special Investigations Unit on Monday.
The SIU is a civilian agency that investigates circumstances involving police and civilians which have resulted in serious injury, sexual assault or death.
